reason: I can afford it, but nobody I know has one of these battery machines yet, and I don't buy anything new until my brother-in-law or the dealer I've used for years tells me it actually works. Also our water comes at fixed times, so the power is not the only problem.
objection: A new kind of battery machine with nobody in the family having tried it. If the battery goes bad after a couple of years, will the dealer really fix it, or will I be left with a heavy box in the corner?
would_change_my_mind: A relative or neighbour using it for a few months and telling me it finishes the wash during power cuts, with my trusted dealer standing behind the battery warranty.
